'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missiles strike the city of [[Chuhuiv]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]], killing three civilians and injuring three others, while more than 50 [[BM-21 Grad|Grad]] rockets hit the city of [[Nikopol, Ukraine|Nikopol]] in [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], killing two people. The missile strikes come after Russian defence minister [[Sergei Shoigu]] ordered the military to expand operations in [[Ukraine]] in order to "protect the [[Donbas]]".  [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/warning-sirens-sound-ukraines-capital-russia-steps-up-bombardment-2022-07-16/ (Reuters)]
***The president of [[Energoatom]], the Ukrainian nuclear energy authority, accuses Russian forces of using the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] to store weapons and shell the surrounding area. [https://www.thejournal.ie/russia-shelling-from-ukraine-nuclear-plant-5818580-Jul2022/ (''The Journal.ie'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
***[[Israel]] launches more than a dozen missiles against two [[Hamas]] targets in the [[Gaza Strip]], following a number of [[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel|rockets fired]] overnight from Gaza into Israel, causing severe damage. No casualties were reported and no civilian structures were targeted or hit. [https://www.voanews.com/a/israel-launches-attack-on-gaza/6661350.html (Voice of America)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/israel-launches-air-raid-on-gaza-after-rocket-launches (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Papua conflict]]
**[[Nogolait shooting]]
***Ten people are killed and two others are injured when gunmen attack civilians in [[Nduga Regency]], [[Highland Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. The [[separatist]] [[West Papua National Liberation Army]] is blamed for the attack. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-8557eab22bda1e03bd3004d2703f31b9 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 European heat waves|July 2022 European heat wave]]
**[[2022 European and MENA wildfires]]
***[[Wildfire|Wildfires]] break out in southwestern [[France]] and [[Spain]] amidst a [[heat wave]] in [[Europe]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/wildfires-rage-france-spain-heatwaves-sweep-europe-2022-07-16/ (Reuters)]  
***In [[Portugal]], a [[Aerial firefighting|waterbombing plane]] crashes in [[Vila Nova de Foz Côa]] while fighting wildfires in the region, killing the pilot, and in Spain, around 2,300 people are evacuated from the [[Costa del Sol]] due to wildfires in the [[Mijas|Mijas hills]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62189272 (BBC News)]
**A report shows that at least 360 people have died in a week during the heat wave in Spain. [https://elpais.com/sociedad/2022-07-16/la-ola-de-calor-deja-360-muertes-entre-el-10-y-el-15-de-julio.html (''El País'')]
*[[Meridian Flight 3032]]
**An [[Antonov An-12]] [[Cargo aircraft|cargo plane]], operated by a Ukrainian airline, crashes near the city of [[Kavala|Kavala, Greece]], killing all eight people on board. The aircraft was carrying weapons from [[Serbia]] to [[Bangladesh]], and crashed before a planned stop in [[Jordan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62195005 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of North Macedonia to the European Union]]
**[[Bulgaria–North Macedonia relations]]
***The [[Assembly of North Macedonia]] passes a motion to amend North Macedonia’s [[Constitution of North Macedonia|Constitution]] to recognise its Bulgarian minority, while pledging to discuss remaining issues with the Bulgarian government. In exchange, Bulgaria will allow membership talks with the [[European Union]] to begin. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/north-macedonia-votes-to-resolve-dispute-with-bulgaria (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Economic sanctions against the United States]]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] of [[Iran]] imposes sanctions on 61 Americans for their association with exiled Iranian dissident group [[People's Mojahedin Organization of Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/iran-imposes-sanctions-61-americans-nuclear-talks-hit-impasse-2022-07-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[G20]] finance leaders end a meeting in [[Bali]] without a joint communique, as consensus could not be reached on multiple issues due to tensions caused by ongoing conflicts between the countries. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/07/17/g20-no-full-consensus-food-security-inflation-ukraine-war-top-agenda.html (CNBC)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Four people are killed and two injured in a [[mass shooting]] in the [[Gauteng]] [[provinces of South Africa|province]] of [[South Africa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nine-killed-separate-shootings-south-africa-police-2022-07-17/ (Reuters)]
*Protests continue in [[Panama]] with road and railways blockades, after protesters rejected [[President of Panama|president]] [[Laurentino Cortizo]]'s concessions. [https://www.prensa.com/provincias/siguen-los-cierres-de-vias-en-chiriqui-veraguas-y-panama-oeste/ (''La Prensa'')]
*[[Crime in Haiti]]
**The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] documents 934 killings, 684 injuries and 680 kidnappings in [[Port-au-Prince]] since the start of 2022, in a sharp increase of violence in the city. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/un-decries-rising-death-toll-rights-violations-in-haiti (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[UN Security Council]] passes a resolution extending the mandate of the UN Integrated Office in Haiti for a further year. [https://news.un.org/en/story/2022/07/1122662 (UN News)]
